subject: Private VPC networking follow-up (VPC peering / PrivateLink / allowlist)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acme.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Private VPC follow-up / next steps

Hi Tom —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

- Deployment options discussed: Hosted API (fastest), Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pools), Private VPC (VPC peering or PrivateLink). You indicated compliance + data residency concerns push you toward Private VPC.
- Network asks we need to validate: whether your network team prefers VPC peering vs AWS PrivateLink, CIDR ranges for peering or endpoint allowlists, and whether traffic will egress through your NAT/GW.
- Security: we’ll need to confirm TLS termination point and any IP allowlist requirements for management/control-plane traffic.

Attachments: I’ve included our Private VPC networking checklist to make the network review faster (redwood-private-vpc-networking-checklist.pdf).

Proposed next steps:
1) Your network lead to confirm preference (peering vs PrivateLink) and share CIDR blocks + public IPs to be allowlisted
2) 30-min technical sync (network + infra) — can you do Tues/Thurs next week?
3) I’ll loop in our infra engineer (Sean) to help with the technical plan and any DocuSign/contracting impacts.

If you prefer, we can start with PrivateLink (faster to stand up in cross-account setups) and then evaluate peering for higher throughput later.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

---
Attachment: redwood-private-vpc-networking-checklist.pdf (application/pdf, 48KB)

From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 09:37:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Private VPC follow-up / next steps

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear summary. I looped in our network lead Jared (cc’d). A few quick answers: 

- Our compliance team prefers PrivateLink where possible because it avoids cross-VPC routing and is simpler for our auditors. That said, we may consider peering if there are throughput concerns.
- We can provide the CIDR ranges and public egress IPs for allowlisting — attaching the initial CIDR list.
- TLS: we’d prefer end-to-end TLS to the Redwood endpoint; we terminate at our side for internal traffic.

Jared — can you confirm the CIDRs and your availability for a 30-min sync next week (Tue/Thu mornings work best for us PST).

Thanks,
Tom
Director, Cloud Platform | Acme Corp
---
Attachment: acme_vpc_cidrs.txt (text/plain)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Cole <jared.cole@acme.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acme.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private VPC follow-up / next steps

Hi Jared —

Great — thanks for jumping in. A couple of technical clarifications to help Sean prepare the runbook before the sync: 

1) If you pick PrivateLink, will you set up an interface endpoint in your VPC and connect to a Redwood endpoint service, or do you need us to create a service in our account and share the service name?
2) For VPC peering: are there overlapping CIDRs we need to be aware of? If so, peering won’t work and we’ll push toward PrivateLink.
3) For allowlists: we need the list of public IPs used by the Redwood control/management plane (we can provide those IPs once we know region). Is your team ok with a short maintenance window if we need to adjust NAT rules?

Sean — can you draft the high-level steps for both PrivateLink and peering (security considerations, estimated time-to-standup, and any cost delta we should flag to Acme)? If you can send a 1-pager before the sync that will speed the meeting.

Proposed time slots: Tue Jul 6, 9:30–10:00am PST or Thu Jul 8, 10:00–10:30am PST. Which works best?

Thanks,
Marissa
---
Attachment referenced: redwood-private-vpc-networking-checklist.pdf

From: Jared Cole <jared.cole@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 15:20:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Private VPC follow-up / next steps

Hi all —

Quick responses from the network side: 
- We prefer PrivateLink (interface endpoint + Redwood service) to avoid routing complexity. Please create the service name and we’ll create the interface endpoint.
- CIDRs: attached (same file Tom sent). No overlapping CIDRs on our side.
- Egress: our traffic to Redwood will come from a small set of NAT egress IPs — see list in the attached file. We can temporarily open a maintenance window if you need to test connectivity.

I’ll be available Tue Jul 6 9:30am PST for a 30-min sync.

Jared Cole
Network Engineer | Acme Corp
